author: Michael Mislan
issue: In the base commit the negative field of CertifiedAutocatalyticTest required a NegativeRationalCertificate for every matching realising a rejected edge set, including the empty matching, whose certificate would need a positive coordinate on an empty index set; accepting the empty set is also impossible because a positive certificate needs a nonzero vector. The checker type was therefore uninhabited and AutocatalyticCS.sourceDirectCSCoreEnum_exact had no instances.

changes.checker: negative now requires a dual certificate only for realising matchings E with E.species.Nonempty. CertifiedAutocatalyticTest.exact is proved from IndexedMatching.species_nonempty_of_autocatalytic.
changes.certificate_completeness: RationalGordan.gordan: Gordan's alternative over ℚ proved by Fourier–Motzkin elimination (induction on the number of columns; each eliminated system is a nonnegative rational combination of the previous rows; the eliminated variable is chosen strictly between finitely many rational bounds). No real numbers, limits or density arguments are used. IndexedMatching.certificate_alternative applies it to the stacked system [M; I] x ≫ 0: for every matching with at least one species there is a PositiveRationalCertificate or a NegativeRationalCertificate.
changes.checker_existence: canonicalCertifiedTest Q (noncomputable, classical decide on AutocatalyticEdgeSet) answers true exactly on autocatalytic edge sets; positive certificates are the semipositivity witnesses; negative certificates come from certificate_alternative for every nonempty realising matching, so alternate indexed representations are handled by quantification. certifiedAutocatalyticTest_nonempty : Nonempty (CertifiedAutocatalyticTest Q) for every finite network. Not an executable rational solver.
changes.applicable_instance: OneSpeciesExample (A → 2A on Unit × Unit, one-edge anchor): exhaustive singleton orders, anchor completeness for OrdinaryCore, IsUniqueMatching of the anchor subgraph, checker existence, IsCore of the one-edge set, and sourceDirectCSCoreEnum … checker = {{((), ())}} for every checker, packaged as OneSpeciesExample.sourceDirectCSCoreEnum_example.
changes.selected_declarations_unchanged: The seven MAFComposition and DegradationControl declarations and the statement of AutocatalyticCS.sourceDirectCSCoreEnum_exact are unchanged; the checker type it quantifies over changed.
changes.challenge: CertifiedAutocatalyticTest.negative mirrored; statements of the three new declarations added; OneSpeciesExample.network and .anchor copied verbatim from the source. Mathlib-only imports; source scopes and public helper names preserved.
changes.manuscript: papers/P011/manuscript/main.tex: Construction 4.6 negative-certificate clause; Theorem 4.7 proof sketch; new Proposition 4.8 (certified tests exist) and Example 4.9 (A → 2A); overview sentence; Perron construction described as the Collatz–Wielandt argument actually formalized (replacing the stale Schauder fixed-point description and its provenance paragraph); verification section notes the submitted Lean 4.35.0-rc2 snapshot and the new declarations. PDF rebuilt with pdflatex/bibtex (25 pages; no undefined references; only new labels 4.8 and 4.9 added) and pages 2, 8–11 and 20–22 visually inspected.
